policy.newsMode: timestamped fact-only briefs, metadata and source links first; no automatic translation
policy.deepMode: multi-source independent reporting, investigations and separately labeled commentary; historical review remains in this line

sources.name: Global Voices
sources.notes: Approved basis for the current issue; full context and attribution required; image omission remains enforced.

sources.name: Taiwan Insight
sources.notes: Strong regional reporting; requires explicit permission before reuse or translation.

sources.name: Hong Kong Free Press
sources.notes: Suitable for context-heavy regional issues; must confirm re-publication and image rights.

sources.name: The Conversation
sources.notes: Useful long-form analysis; acceptable only if republishing permissions are explicit.

sources.name: The China Project
sources.notes: Strong regional context coverage; must be individually checked for public reuse.

sources.name: Reuters
sources.notes: Useful for fact-only translation when rights permit; no opinion expansion.

sources.name: AP News
sources.notes: Good candidate for objective event reporting; only permitted when reuse terms are explicit.

sources.name: BBC News
sources.notes: News translation candidate only; must not be treated as a fully open source.

sources.name: Fox News
sources.license: terms review required; metadata-only RSS intake
sources.notes: Separate straight reporting from opinion and editorial framing; attribute claims and do not assume neutrality or consensus.

sources.name: DW
sources.license: terms review required; metadata-only RSS intake
sources.notes: German public international broadcaster; useful for an additional reporting frame, not a substitute for primary evidence.

sources.name: France24
sources.notes: Useful international reporting source; needs per-story licensing check.

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.notes: Good fact-reporting source when explicit reuse terms are available; avoid commentary reuse.
